Daisy: Don’t be fooled by the gentle nature of her name ladies and gentlemen. Beautiful, yes, sensitive, yes, but Daisy is so much more than that. There’s a theory rummaging around in the commentary box that Daisy is one of the best female names in existence, and we don’t say that publicly very often. What does that mean, you might ask? Well, bloody hell, pick a category, Daisy is just top notch. She listens, she loves, she tries new things, she waltzes into the room and people fall over themselves to try and meet her, and she loves meeting new people. Her radar for idiots is ace, she always smells nice and that smile melts hearts. What more can we say?
Dale: A nice lady with a wonderful intent who, when she gets on in years, unwittingly leaves strange parcels of gifts on the doorsteps of all of her neighbours. They will contain things like lollies, rotting onions, scissors, old jars of relish, half-filled boxes of white wine and if you’re really lucky, an old painting and maybe even a pair of underpants.
Damara: Like a butterfly emerging from a chrysalis, Damara has two distinct life phases. As a young girl she loves donuts and coke, and old people see her walking down the street and imagine she has been dressed by aliens. Then in adulthood we observe a reserved and rather elegant creature who has well and truly left her bogan/redneck roots behind. She has persisted with the makeup, however.
Dami: Dami is one of the few people in the Kingdom who struggles to scare anyone. She leaps out from behind a door and rather than shit yourself, you only feel this strange fuzzy feeling in your belly, like your best friend has just said hello at the front door. She’s just too nice and her energy is too welcoming, but that energy is put to good use everywhere else. If you meet her you’re liable to either fall in love with her or adopt her as a new best friend.
Dana: Dana generally has short hair, and she’s make a splendid Harley Davidson-riding lesbian who adores women with a nice bum and a short skirt, just as she’d make a splendid, gorgeous, proactive, heterosexual mum who was involved with her family, the community and the local latin dance class. Dana is one of those delicious women who can do it all and she’s never out of place. Nice one Dana. x
Daneeka: Daneeka, some advice from the commentary box: You ARE worthy of the captaincy! All you have to do is believe you are too.
Danelle: Danelle is the chilled-out and subtle comedienne of the group. Sarcastic and very bright, why and how men miss her attractiveness is a question we up here in the commentary box have been scratching our head over for ages. Maybe she's just too smart for them?
Danica: Danica gets bored. Baby, what do you want? If money was no option, seriously, what would do with your days? Because, my love, THAT'S WHAT YOU'RE MEANT TO BE DOING! Management.
Danieka: Pinpoint in her criticism, her compliments and her corners, if she heads off on a long road trip you can expect her to arrive within 5 minutes of when she said she would, having used the exact amount of fuel that she expected to use - and yes, she did all the necessary calculations beforehand. Hitch hikers? Not a chance.
Daniella: Daniella rhymes with Mecca, and for most men, at least, she exists only as a distant image. In life she may be accustomed to a certain amount of latitude but there is no denying her rather dramatic presence.
Danielle: The name of a Grand piano whose owner insists she gets tuned, cleaned and dusted every Monday afternoon. It actually drives her bananas because all she wants to do is relax and play wonderful music, which might explain why she has such a horrible temper.
Danika: She's hard going, sometimes, but some within the Kingdom, or should I say, some souls within the Kingdom have deemed it necessary to take their owners on a journey of hard work and redemption. I'm buggered if I know how it works, but the fact that Danika was a Mongol chieftian in a previous life, who killed village people by the score, probably has an awful lot to do with the fact that, today, she is a busy, fretful and compassionate Hospital Director. It seems that Karma has a tendency to catch up with all of us in the end.
Danique: Somewhere between a perfect technique which results in unimaginably grandiose outcomes with a minimal of effort, and a full knee reconstruction that most gun-netballers experience at some point in their lives, Danique exists as a tantalising example of what might be possible. It is therefore a given that she is slightly eccentric.
Danka: Danka approaches all aspects of her life like one of those idiots in Scotland, or somwhere, who deliberately race down a very steep hill, on foot. Invariably, they accelerate so quickly that many of the contestants wind up sommersaulting through thin air at God-awful speeds. It's hilarious to watch and bloody dangerous to take part in. And yes, Danka has the scars and the bruises to prove it, but what she also has are very well developed stomach muscles from laughing so much. Imagine if we all suffered from the same fate?
Danna: Don't overlook Danna. Beneath all her directions, she's actually quite a thoughtful and chilled-out girl. For some reason known only to the universal gods, and quite like Doris, actually, people around her are often slightly crazy, which stresses her out. But I wonder, was she put here on Earth to try and encourage these poeple to relax, and to let go of their fear?...
Dannette: The Uncompromising Rancher. Mending large gates, doing up horse buckles tightly, putting down injured cattle, branding, yelling loudly at dogs and farm hands, cutting off wire with gloves and industrial wire cutters, having only one shower per month: this is Dannette's lot. Things need to be kept in check and you've got to be organised, because you just never know when adversity will strike. Parties? Impuslive fun? Sometimes, maybe, but this is a large hands-on operation and someone has to ensure it's running smoothly 24/7.
Danni: Danni is a gifted genius no-one understands and she is always just a little bit lost. She cops a lot for her beliefs and if she wasn’t such a decent person, deep down, she would have made a great spy.
Dannika: An effervescent young woman with bounce in her step and a frisky demeanour. Her family are slightly twisted, but she’s shaken off that mantle and become her own powerhouse. Cute grin too, and she uses it, as she should. Amen.
Danuta: Sure, Danuta likes getting nude, but her university days are behind her - back then she was first to skinny-dip. More significant, Danuta needs something to do and she loves energetic gatherings. The last thing you'd try (let's say, if you were attempting to win her heart as a gentleman) is to take her to a game of Test Cricket. You'd never see her again. Aside from that, she'll never shy away from confrontation and she's a chaotic cook.
Daphne: Another walking, talking Enigma. It takes a lot to get into the 'inner sanctum' of her private life, and her radar is pretty amazing, hence not just anyone will cut the mustard. But, once you're there, Daphne is an exquisite example of a funny, artistic, giving, sensual woman. Best of all, she loves to play.
Dara:
Great in business, Dara has a cutthroat attitude in deals and consequently she’s rarely broke. Keep your eye on the prize and don’t forget what your goals are: this is what she’ll tell you. 
Occasionally perhaps she needs to laugh more than she does but who knows, she looks pretty happy to us, in which case she needs to keep doing what she’s doing.
Daragh: Common as Irish rain, Daragh is bloody funny and wholly present. With a constant smile that she carries everywhere, she’s proof that all anyone needs to do in order to be happy is to bloody-well decide that they’re going to be happy. It doesn’t sound too hard, does it?
Darby: Posh Spice, eat your heart out.
Darci: Ever seen the Monty Python skit involving the World Championship of Hide and Seek? The game starts with one guy counting to 100 with his hands over his eyes, while his competitor takes a taxi to the airport and gets on a plane bound for the Middle East. Anyway, that just about sums up Darci's approach to everything. In a nutshell, retain a sense of humour at all times and good luck! She’s nearly always worth the trip.
Darcie: Okay, go and have a look at Darci before you read any further…….okay, welcome back. Unlike Darcy and Darci, this one spends more time removing chewie-gum from the bottom of her runners.
Darcy: Darcy has a dimpled smile and is occasionally extremely sarcastic. As a sensual being from millions of years ago, today she’s an intense girl who generally gets what she wants. Boys love her.
Daria: Diligent and busy, Daria possesses an excellent work ethic and everyone, be they man or woman, suspects she is simply amazing in bed.
Darian: There’s a good chance she is quite domineering – especially if she’s South African – but Darian’s great quality is that she speaks only the truth, whether it hurts for someone to hear it or not.
Darlene: Thank God someone is keeping it real today. Yes, she puts a nip of whisky in warm milk and gives it to wailing children to shut them up, but so what? They sleep longer, we sleep longer, and everyone is happy.
Darnae: Darnae is as beautiful on the inside as she is on the outside. Full stop.
Darrylee: Drama - why is it some people love and/or attract it? I don't get it. I'll never get it, I don't think, but that's not my job. In this case, it's Darrylee who attracts these chaotic moments and people. I wonder if, in a past life, she was a humble seamstress working in a cold, glum, northern European clothes shop for 50 years? Either way, she's now here to jump into stuff, crash her car into things, spill drinks and break hearts, all with a gay abandon, and she will drive you crazy. It’s her job.
Daryl:
Even in today's frantic world, Daryl is one of those few creatures in the Kingdom who seems to have time, and this enables her to think about things, ponder her decisions and contemplate the world around her, as well as those in it. "Hello Daryl," you'll say to her. "Well, hello to  you," she'll say in return, and she'll be smiling whether she knows you or not.
What a lovely day.
Davina: Exotically charismatic and temperamental, Davina is the chief curator for most of our best art galleries.
Dawn: Her name sounds like a rubber gum boot being extracted from a pond of mud, but she’s far sweeter and savvier that that. Yes, Dawn is understated, but beneath her skin is a beautiful and generous soul and on her day she is fucking hilarious.
Dayle:
Once again we find ourselves in the middle of the desert. The car has barely made it to town, if you call this a town, and you need a mechanic desperately. Hark! The only garage for 200 miles appears to be open although at first glance you can’t hear anything in the heat.
“Hello?” you say, as you walk into the blissful shade of the shed. “Anyone here?”
“...yeah, I’ll just be tick,” a gruff woman’s voice says, unseen. “I’m just droppin’ the kids off at the pool.”
Perplexed, you stand and wait. There are tools and car bits and crap everywhere. A toilet flushes from out the back, you hear cursing and boots on concrete. A tap is turned on and water splashes. A person groans with pleasure. Dayle appears in the doorway bedraggled. Her face is wet and she’s wiping her hands on her grey overalls which appear to be older than the sun. 
“How ya’ gaaaarn?” she says. “Is it hot enough for ya? Let me guess, you’ve cooked it haven’t ya?”
Dayle.
Dayna: Dayna is a savage hunter. Indeed, she'd make a very beautiful and confronting savage on a desert island too, but that's another story. She's one of the few people who look incredible with a shaved head and she's never single.
Deah: Deah is many things, but first and foremost she is ready - ready for change. The usual hum-drum of life is something she copes with pretty easily, but what she's searching for (and secretly needs) is some chaos, some passion, an exhibition of irreverent stupidity and an act of chivalrous idiocy. So, the question is, who and/or what will provide it?...
Deana:
Like her twin sister Deanna, Deana doesn’t spend much time wondering why something didn’t work.
"Come on, buck up," she'll say if things haven't gone your way. "What are you going to do? Sit around here and mope all day? Not in this house! Come on now, what can I do to help?"
Deanna: Forthright. She pushes her kids hard and they're up for it. It's good for them, and Deanna, meanwhile, manages to keep it all together, and she's more laid back and definitely sexier than she sounds….
Deb: Welcome to a wonderful and unsung Enigma. The length of her name is exactly inversely proportional to her level of charisma, sexiness, directness and her capacity to get the job done. Deb is a marvel.
Debbie: A tough hombre in all situations, she overcomes hurdles in an instant with a smile and a huff of having to deal with the occasional idiot. Does she get kissed enough?
Debora: The modern-day fuss-pot who frowns when she should be smiling. Not all the time of course, but perhaps she should just do more of it. How does one accomplish this? We can’t advise anyone to drink more champagne, but fuck it, Debora, drink more champagne. You’ve got a good heart and your kids will be fine, so stop worrying because everything else is fluff. Management.
Debra: Debra doesn’t piss-fart around. Sure, she’s got style and brains and a sense of humour, and she’s sexier than even she possibly realises, but her great skill is forcing others to get their shit together. (Note: It is a given that hers already is, unless she flies off the handle, in which case disregard the entire paragraph.)
Decima: Maths teacher. Diligent and highly intelligent, Decima expects a lot from her charges and is never shy about admonishing those she considers not reaching their potential. The education system could do with a few more like her, as a matter of fact.
Dee: Dee has 11 children and lives a busy life. Flustered by very little, as a younger woman she was drop-dead gorgeous.
DeeMay: Dee May is a tough opponent in a debating contest because she researches her topic meticulously. Her arguments therefore are generally indefensible. She is quite successful professionally, as you can imagine, and her house is full of big personalities and laughter, as well as good food and wine. She’s a stickler for good table manners.
Dejana:
“Oh no, not another drama, Dejana! So, did you own up this time?”(Dejana balks….she turns her head…she flips her hair……she looks away.)
"...Ah, not yet…but I will. I promise!" she says. (ie. Operation normal.)
Delaney: The sophisticate. Her tasks and standards arise from a life lived surrounded by artisans and great expectations, and as such she has been afforded the luxury of desiring more of those nights filled with stories and sexual intrigue. Is she conceited? Well…..maybe, but, then again, her friends would never agree with that. (Just avoid adding too much Botox, honey: Management.)
Deleese: As a rather brilliant and magnetic soul, she repeatedly sets social precedents by doing something as banal as walking out the front door. Time - she has oodles of it, both for leisure and a good come-back, if it’s warranted. She understands the game of life and how absurd most things are, which means she’s good for the rest of us. Good luck is her ally.
Delia: The name of the brief head-bow that combative martial artists (who are both smiling quietly because each knows how good they are) give to one another before entering into battle. So, are you ready?
Delin: Delin is a diligent and dedicated deligator and we encourage anyone who knows her to buy her joke books and plane tickets, and sex toys if you know her well enough, and on the proviso that you keep it a secret.
Dell: Instructive and upright, Dell bloody-well gets on with things. Rural or not she wears sensible knickers and isn’t beyond fisticuffs if need be. She asks excellent, pertinent questions.
Della:
It's the Olympic final of the 100metre sprint for women. All the training comes down to this. The starter's gun is raised and an eerie hush fills the stadium. Della is primed, but OH NO! She's jumped the gun! Years of hard toil down the drain and amid the despair of her first few metres, she makes a decision.
She decides to keep on running the race, on her own. By the time she crosses the finish line, having run a PB, 100,000 people are egging her on. Della.
Delma:
"Oh, Barb!" she says, almost embarrassed at her good friend's outrageous behaviour in the expensive restaurant. "Will you leave that poor young waiter alone?" 
(Secretly, of course, she wants to flirt with him too.)
Delphi: In a past life Delphi was a world famous pirate trapped in the body of a mermaid, and to be honest it used to piss her off. Sure, she lured many-a-sailor to their grave but this was never her intention. All Delph’ ever wanted - and all she ever wants in this life, as a matter of fact -  was to gather up a bunch of like-minded larrikins and have as much fun as humanly possible. Danger barely registers with her so you better hang on, as her multitude of friends can attest. And don’t give her an outlandish dare, whatever you do…
Delphia: Her name rises up and prepares itself like a big, beautiful cobra being wooed from its cane nest by it's charmer. Yes, Delphia is tantalising and beautiful, she has attitude and she can look after herself, don't worry about that, but you may not know that she is also very loving. She wants those around her to rise up, just like her. Not bad eh?
Delphin:
Delphin never gets sanctioned, never gets told off and seems to fall into favour with just about everyone. How does she do this? Perhaps it’s because she has plenty of time, she reads people very well - as well as being well read, herself - and she sticks to the plan. Not prone to sudden crazy rushes of impulse, we wonder if maybe she should give them a go?
And yes, she’s a deeply romantic woman.
Delrae: With quite a masculine name, Delrae takes her time, as she should. The journey (and in her case it’s a rather seductive one) is the secret and so long as you trust her you’ll be fine. She’s smarter than you are, probably, so just relax. D will take care of you.
Delta: Perfectly shaped with a mystical kind of presence, but something about Delta is completely upside down...
Delwyn: Delwyn plans ahead with diligence and nous, all the with the knowledge that things can change quickly and unpredictably. Rather than fear these unexpected hitches, Delwyn embraces them because she always enjoys the humour of the moment. Big laugh.
Demelza: Difficult to pin down, either literally or philosophically, once you get to them you will discover that Demelza has strongly held opinions which are both fair and equitable. Yes, she fiddles around and gets lost sometimes, usually retaining her sense of humour in the process, but she encourages those around her to have fun. She's good friends with her kids.
Demi: Demi is about 4 inches tall and wears a tiny little tutu. She plays the flute and flies around the sky using her dragonfly wings, while at the same time casting spells on people that force them to smile giddily, and dream of lemonade and/or fornicating in fields.
Denella:
There are two species of Denella…

Denellas metropollosis : A city slicker who wouldn’t be seen dead in last season’s jacket. She communicates through a wide range of eyebrow movements and hair flicks, and is attracted to men who, when topless, resemble some kind of dehydrated insect. 

Denellas slugaloungas : A tracksuit-wearing slob who rarely leaves the couch. She has a TV remote stuck to her hand and the notion of exercise involves getting up and walking to the fridge, although the more intelligent specimens have learned to position said device within reaching distance of where she reclines.

We’re hoping to hear news of a third species, as yet undescribed…
Denise: Denise has been through three divorces and is tired of bullshit, although she hasn’t lost her sense of humour. She is now more comfortable in her skin than she’s ever been.
Denita: Idealistic. If she isn’t a full-blown political animal, then Denita is intimately involved with issues regarding personal or human rights within society.
Denver: Cute, yes, but Denver is just a little bit shy.
Derrian: It's interesting that some people are better at manifesting different things into their lives than others, isn't it? Derrian is one of those. What does she manifest, I hear you ask? Well, languid trips away, relaxed cocktail evenings under warm starry nights and the laughter of friends - these are some of the things that attract to Derrian's life. Does she work hard? I've no idea. That's none of our business and probably none of hers.
Derryn: Best friends with Ruby and Rae. Need we say anymore?
Des:
Nickname or not, Des is like some magic form of relaxed glue which makes everything better. She is rarely stressed, she’s always funny, she has a million friends and there are many many men (and ladies if the situation ever presented) who would love nothing more than to spend several hours/days/years curled up in her company. 
Note: She’s a little tired of being the go-to person whenever someone has a petty drama to relieve themselves of.
DeShan: Big personality, giant heart, De Shan attracts dramas like nobodies business. Yes, she fell asleep at the wheel once, wrote the car off and woke up without a scratch, proof that someone or something up there is looking out for her. She shrugged off a regular life a long time ago. Yes, she's an artist, and an actress, and a comedienne. Ostensibly unembarrassable, in a past life De Shan was another gorgeous, black Spanish bull except she's not here to hurt anyone. She's here to help, and to have buckets of fun, naturally.
Desi: Oh my lord, Desi's father is just about going insane with the number of boys who keep turning up at his door, asking for his daughter's hand in marriage. Desi, of course, has so many engagement rings that she had to create an entire draw for them. And rightly so.
Desiree: Feathers - she loves them. She loves being tickled by them, she likes some of her clothes to be made from them and in a perfect world, on hot days, two black, naked slave men would fan her with a giant peacock feather, each. She’s crazy when she’s drunk and her blood is up.
Desley:
"Good morning, Geeves," she says, running passed him in only a bra and a pair of white panties. She's late again, and it's not like he's never seen her semi-naked before in this situation. 
"Good morning, madame," he replies, reverently. But then he raises his voice, hopefully, after her. "Will you be dining-in this evening? The caviar arrived this morning fresh from St. Petersburg?"
"Oh, shit!" Desley yells behind her, back down the corridor. "Sorry Geeves, I've got dinner at that bloody actor's house, tonight. Will it keep?"
Geeves smiles quietly, to himself, almost. "That's perfectly alright, madame. I'm sure it will."
Her name is Desley, and so it goes.....
Deslie: Now Deslie, I know - you're not 'ey'. That's okay. And deep down you know it is too. You and your sister aren't normal and for this reason we love you. So, head on over to Desley and we'll have a drink afterwards. The crew up here in the commentary box will be surprised if you hate them for not separating the two of you.
Desmaralda: Good mates with Annie, Desmaralda is the name of a special kind of polkadot dress, where the 'dots' are actually little round holes that have been cut out of the material.
Desmia: She's funny. For instance, say she gets sick and tired of tripping over all of her shoes scattered around the floor, one day she decides to make an inventory of exactly how many pairs she owns (before she puts them all away). Three minutes into the task, involving a notepad and pen, swearing and cursing all the way, a girlfriend will ring her with a luncheon invite, at which point Desmia will feign disappointment, toss the notebook over her head, don the pair of stilettos she happens to have in her hand and be out the door. Then, at 3am that night, or the next, she'll stumble in the door and trip over a pair of shoes, cracking her elbow on the corner of her bed. Then she curses again. How she gets anything done is beyond us, but she's fun to watch and the boys love her.
Despina: Oh, Despina! Don't worry about it! I know, the dress is ruined but, honestly, you're got your health, you're kids are having a good time and are good people, you live in a nice house filled with love and laughter, your days are fun and busy, and so what if that stupid woman spilt strawberry sauce all down the front of you? Life could be worse.....Indeed, I'm not sure it can get any better.  Love Management. x
Dessie: Yes, she’s had fun, but she grew tired of the party drugs and the associated wankers - all the good ones do. Today she is very real and very lovely.
Devaki: Devaki is a nice girl who, too often, tries to fit too much inside boxes that are too small. But it's fun to watch her try.
Dewi: Ah, delicious Dewi. LIke a male Gilly way after her, Dewi's smile is larger than her face and she's therefore impossible to say no to. Colours: she fills her life with them - in her wardrobe, in her house - and she's an experimental cook. The louder and the more esoteric the accompanying music, the better.
Deyana: This girl lives for peaches ’n cream, preferably in bowl or on a plate, but she can handle them poured anywhere on her body, really. Some call it art. Like Kenny way after her, there is some question as to what she does with her time. Does she work? Does she own a car? Anyone have any idea?...
Di: A cool cat. She has short dusty blonde hair, she can light a campfire, take a funny restaurant order and she can organise 100 kids at once. Yep, Di is excellent value. Did I say she was sexy?
Diana: Always busy busy busy. Forget all that Princess rubbish, Diana is a modern lass who juggles the whole damn thing - kids, husbands, work, life, you name it - and does it with aplomb. Money isn’t really an issue for her, but perhaps she needs to employ a cleaner or something because one always feels compelled to fetch a seat for her as soon as she enters the room.
Diane: Diane is surrounded by orthodoxy and, to be honest, she's a bit over it. Where is the fizz in life? Why doesn't her husband bring her presents like he used to? Maybe it's time for a change? The sad thing is, whether she likes being called Di or not, Dianes stopped being produced years ago, which means she and her rather stunning sister (Di) will soon be extinct and, excuse my language, but that is a fucked situation.
Dianna: Shameful? Never. Her ego is way too large to admit defeat or even an error. It may be because of the inner-fortitude gained from having corrected so many people on the spelling of her name. We’ll never know. Good in battle, passionate in the boudoir, impatient in the kitchen, Dianna fulfils her role as the Somewhat Dissatisfied Matriarch.
Dianne: She'd never visit a nudist camp, that's for sure. Maybe she should? It'd loosen those shoulders that aren't being massaged nearly enough.
Dillan: Dillan can delegate, she can shake it in a sexy dress, she can disarm the most determined, deluded drunk in any room and she has a great laugh. She should be a manager/producer of sorts - be it for radio, stage or for a marketing firm. Her radar is very good and she sums up people quickly and quietly, moulding her response to fit the situation. Her tomboy start has made her one hell of a savvy performer out there in the real world. Nice work Dillan.
Dilys: Her life is filled to the brim with high comedy and high drama, usually occurring at the same time. For example, the last time she went on a giant water slide she got out of the pool at the bottom and was mortified to discover her entire bikini had been torn from her body during the descent, which meant of course that she was standing naked in a public place. If she was at a dance/hedonism festival in the desert such attire wouldn't be a problem, indeed, it's often encouraged, but this is boring middle-class white-man country we're talking about. Dilys.
Dimitra: Dimitra will put up with quite a bit. She worked in her parents business for a long time as a little girl so that silly, playful edge has been eroded somewhat. Like Carol, Dimitra could do with a holiday.
Dimity: A very driven and self-assured lass, Dimity goes pretty hard and generally in the right direction. It's actually quite impressive to watch.
Dione: Dione is an industrious lass who always looks busy and concerned. Yes, women are being encouraged to stand on their own two feet these days, away from the implied protections/expectations of the past that says they should find themselves a man of means to look after them, and Dione represents this ideal more than most. And bravo! She doesn't really tolerate buffoons and she expects quite a lot of her children.
Dior: Dior has handed out more fake orgasms than most. Dior, some advice from Management, don’t waste your time. Just speak the truth because that’s all any of us have. The end.
Dixie: No, she ain't normal. So, lets just have a look at Dixie's past lives, shall we? In WW2 she flew Mustangs for the US Airforce in Europe where she spent her months blowing up Nazis. In Roman times we see here she was one of the few successful slaves who attained freedom in the colosseum by spearing angry lions, and in Paris in the 30's her legs and her smile were famous. Yep, Dixie was made to move and be a rambunctious, flamboyant extravert, which may or may not be true today. People love her. They always have. They always will. It's all about ridiculous, dangerous fun, you understand, and Dixie wrote the book. Amen.
Djana: Djana wears matching jewellery and is eager to impress people. She possesses a stylish walk and somehow manages to stand casually with her legs crossed.
Dolly:
Big boobs, maybe, but there is more to her than that. To cope with this nickname – if it’s a nickname – requires a personality with spunk, intelligence and an unselfconscious sense of fun. 
(Note: Normal-sized or small-breasted Dollys are often even funnier and more intriguing, only because they aren’t compelled to surrender to their title.)
Dolores: What a woman? She’s helped so many men and women that needed a little bit of love or money that it isn’t funny.
Dominique: A double agent who has a foot in the KGB. She’ll do what she needs to do without fear nor favour. She’s as sexy as hell and it makes her job a lot easier.
Donna: Somewhere in her heritage is a struggling mum living in a humpy, but not anymore. Today, Donna is an adaptable and pro-active whip-cracker who thinks it all, does it all and laughs heaps amid the cacophony of modern life. Madame, take a bow.
Donnella: For Pete’s sake stop worrying about other peoples’ shit. They’ll work it out, and they’ll be better for having sorted it out themselves. Go and have some fun D!
Dora:
Dora is the sort of girl who, 70 seconds before the news goes live to air, will burst into the producer's studio with an important communiqué sweating and panting heavily, having just ran at full speed from the fax machine which is three floors up.
“We have to lead with this,” she says, already pulling up a seat and beginning to type.
The producer just nods. If Dora suggests that things need to be reshuffled in a hurry he or she knows they need to be.
Dora.
Dorani:
Perhaps a career is coming, but in the meantime her and her rather stunning entourage are happiest at that rooftop bar - you know the one, in summer, with that exclusive membership thingo’? Anyway, are they full of it? Well, yep, but it’s summer, they’re gorgeous, and does anyone have responsibilities on such a night? 
(Note: You’ll never see her wearing an outfit with a NASA badge on the front of it.)
Doreen: The great and sacred cow. She lives in the fields of India, not far from the River Ganges, and munches thick lush grass, all day long, disbelieving of how perfect each one of them is.
Dori: Dori is the happy-go-lucky sidekick who should be the leader. She’s cute, she laughs easily and if she were a bird she’d be a busy little Honeyeater.
Doris: Who knows what she looks like but she’s a great comedienne. Sexy or not, she attracts more weirdos than anyone else in the kingdom and, consequently, she needs to carry a gun.
Dorit: It's not that she's flustered, really, but why does Dorit always look like she's late? I don't get it. She's a smart lass who understands how the world functions - maybe that's it? Perhaps she spends more time than she should concerned about how the process is going to turn out rather than how it's going here in this second. She has to concentrate heavily while driving.
Dorota: Dorota has her standards and she will only cross those boundaries if and when she is sure the time is right.
Dorote: Her European heritage gives her a certain measured grace, but sometimes it’s just fun to walk down to the local park at lunchtime, rip all your gear off and jump around like silly loon!!
Dorothy: Dorothy is a fence paling that’s fallen off due to the nails rusting out completely and she now lies on the back lawn that has grown so tall around her that you can barely see her. Poor Dorothy, you might say, but beneath her is a teeming metropolis of snails, worms, bugs and beetles that she lovingly tends. She’s been nominated for this year’s Nobel Peace Prize and let’s hope she wins it – she deserves it.
Dotty: Walk into an adult shop that deals with special toys and it gives you whole new perspective on the normal folk you see walking down the street every day. And praise be the Lord, Dotty is leading the charge.
Drew: Beware the Sleeping Dragon. I’ll say that again….  BEWARE THE SLEEPING DRAGON!!
Duglass: A woman cannot be called Dug, or Duglass, unless she is in the Top 10 most charismatic, outgoing and love-generating people on the planet. Please utter a small prayer of thanks if you hear that one exists. Bless you.
Dulcie: Wow, what a dollop of sexy, playful, irreverent bubble of fun and joy and perfectly cooked everything! A killer smile. A heart larger than Madagascar.
Dumas: Her parents are hopeless romantics and that’s okay, but Dumas is a rather hard-headed business woman who has lots said behind her back, not much of which is pleasant. How pathetic is that? (If you have something to say to her, just go and say it. She’s not as harsh as you think and she’ll be shocked at the gossip, which will be mostly bullshit anyway.)
Dusty: Dusty is nearly always a blonde, but she is definitely a Top 5 Enigma. Not just because of the rarity of her existence, but because the power, spunk and savvy coolness of this goddess is inversely proportional to her number in the wild. So, never try and put her in a cage and get as many photographs of her as you can, although like Duglass above her, you’ll be lucky if you even see one.
Dylan:
We're forever pondering how is it some names on a man are so utterly different to what they are on a woman? For instance, a male Lindsay is usually gentle and placid, while a female Lindsay is sharp and precise, and almost a little unstable. A male Kerry is a leader of industry and of men, whereas a female Kerry is skilled at buying the milk (okay, so that’s a bit of a stretch and we aplogise), but you get the gist.
So, here we have a female Dylan, and do you really need us to tell you of the potency of this lass in comparison to her male counterpart? She-Dylan is dynamite. She is smart and proactive. She says she cares about her hair but none of us believe it. Dylan is busy and she is industrious, and she couldn’t give a rat’s arse if people suddenly seem to believe she ought to be humiliated. Indeed, is Dylan embarrassable? It’s a good question. 
Either way, as soon as the war starts ring her up and get her around. If she's next to you then you'll very probably live.
Dymphia: Yeah, good luck putting her in a pigeonhole, well, unless you want her to catch one or two - at her suggestion, I might add - and cook them up using that ancient Belgian recipe that her grandmother gave her. Oh yes, Dymphia can cook, and she can eat too. Men's hearts a lot of the time. But this is Dymphia, you see. She starts the journey, takes a left turn that is odd, and turns it into a bizarre kind of celebration. The results are never expected, and for this reason she is never unhappy. Truth be known, neither are we. (No one has any idea what she does as a career.)
Dyna: Dyna would make a great long-distance space traveller, not only because she can put herself into a coma without too much preparation, but because apart from being a gifted lateral thinker, her calm and understanding nature means that she is good company for any amount of time.
Dzenita: Precocious in youth, worried in adulthood.
